forecast_scope: Twelve aggregate point forecasts per seed; no individual-condition numerical forecasts.

endpoint_definitions.native_mean_probability: Mean original-answer softmax probability for the native reference over all 1024 cases.
endpoint_definitions.native_accuracy: Fraction of native-reference full-16-class argmax predictions equal to the original answer over all 1024 cases.
endpoint_definitions.primary_correct_mean_probability: Equal-layout mean original-answer probability under correct guards across all 105 layouts and 1024 cases.
endpoint_definitions.primary_correct_accuracy: Equal-layout mean correct-guard accuracy across all 105 layouts and 1024 cases.
endpoint_definitions.primary_correct_min_layout_query_accurac: Minimum accuracy among all 105 times 4 correct-guard layout/query cells, with 256 cases per query.
endpoint_definitions.primary_native_minus_correct_probability: Paired native minus correct-guard original-answer probability, equally averaged over 105 layouts.
endpoint_definitions.primary_correct_minus_mean_shams_probabi: Within each of 102 eligible layouts, correct-guard original-answer probability minus the equal mean of every feasible sham; then equal mean over eligible layouts. The 624 shams are not pooled with equal weight across layouts.
endpoint_definitions.boundary_logical_prefix_accuracy: Equal-layout mean logical_prefix accuracy over 2415 layouts and the first 256 balanced cases.
endpoint_definitions.boundary_own_key_self_accuracy: Equal-layout mean own_key_self accuracy over 2415 layouts and the first 256 balanced cases.
endpoint_definitions.boundary_logical_prefix_fraction_layout_: Fraction of all 2415 times 4 logical_prefix layout/query cells with point accuracy at least .95; 64 cases per query.
endpoint_definitions.boundary_own_key_self_fraction_layout_qu: Fraction of all 2415 times 4 own_key_self layout/query cells with point accuracy at least .95; 64 cases per query.
endpoint_definitions.edge_wrong_value_difference_of_changes: For each added edge Vi<-Kj, restrict to query Kj. Per case compute [P_edge(Vi)-P_correct(Vi)] minus the mean of [P_edge(Vk)-P_correct(Vk)] for the two displayed wrong values k not in {i,j}. Average cases within the eligible query stratum, then average all six edge means equally. Correct refers to grouped correct guard.

forecast_interpretation: Judgmental point estimates, identical across unseen seeds; tolerance is practical, not a confidence or predictive interval. Report all 72 errors and misses plus MAE/RMSE separately from scientific decisions.

primary_design.sham_weighting: equal within layout, then equal over eligible layouts

boundary_design.missing_context_scope: Both earlier keys and earlier values may be absent.

primary_gates.global_rule: All validity and primary empirical gates must pass in every fixed seed; no exclusions or replacements.

secondary_gates.global_rule: Each endpoint has a separate all-six-seed decision; no secondary result rescues primary failure.

bootstrap.shared_weights: Within each panel, identical row weights across all layouts, conditions, and seeds.
bootstrap.edge_weighting: Use normalized global bootstrap weights within each edge eligible query stratum, then equal mean of six edges; q0 is descriptive only for this contrast.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fixed checkpoints and input distribution; no across-model inference; pointwise intervals are not simultaneous.
